reviews.title: Need to have file support
reviews.text: I like the price options with the ability to use different engines for different purposes, but there seems to be no plan in include the use of files either as an input or output in your activity. I talked to technical support about this and they don’t seem to think this is important or a priority.  I won’t be renewing and will spend my money on something more functional.

reviews.title: 1984 Social Credit has ARRIVED
reviews.text:
If you allow the updated terms of use, your inquiry is sent to a third-party server. You are allowing everything that is on your phone such as pictures, text , emails and other data to be used by multiple large language models in the answer. It let these LLM to build a profile of your behavior or interests. With this information, LLMS can pop-up ads, analyze and profile. The FCC is investigating this problem. 
I subscribed to ChatGPT, but cannot use it unless I agree to these new terms of use.
Thank you for responding to my review. I will reread your terms and conditions. And if I misinterpreted them, I will agree to terms and condition.  The third-party server particularly bothered me with all of the other LLM’s having an to the information. Who controls the third-party server? Have all LLM‘s agreed to these exact terms and conditions?

reviews.title: Be Very Aware
reviews.text: I downloaded this app in error. Thinking I was downloading ChatGPT. I think it was the similar logo that decieved me. In comparrison with ChatGPT; Chat-On is a much, much inferior product. I don‘t know why but it took me a while to realise my mistake; and believe me it was an expensive one to boot. App Store has refused me a refund! I persisted in trying to use this app to produce many images that I have described in detail and exercised a great deal of patience; but on the whole I have just wasted hours and hours of irretrievable time. The moment I realised my mistake was when I downloaded and tried out the REAL ChatGPT. I then discovered that my requested images could be  splendidly produced and would be perfect interpretations of my detailed descriptions, and all this for free and within minutes (i.e. without a costly yearly subscription) I have now moved over to using the said ChatGPT app on a permanent basis with a great deal of satisfaction: I have therefore cut my losses and deleted Chat-On, even though my yearly subscription has yet got some months to run before it expires. I am definitely going to avoid wasting any more of my valuable time. Thank goodness.

Pomimo wielu prób dojścia do efektu (tak prostego jak usunięcie czegoś z obrazka) chat za każdym razem tworzył mi nowy obraz. Jak otwierałam nowy chat żeby próbować inaczej komunikować komendy, było to samo. Powtarza się to nagminnie. Co opadną mi emocje z wkurzenia, próbuje znowu korzystać (skoro już te ponad 200zl mi pobrało bez możliwości zwrotu) i znowu jest totalne gówno i frustracja.

Aplikacja została pobrana przeze mnie przypadkowo – byłam przekonana, że dostępny jest darmowy okres próbny i że mogę anulować subskrypcję bez ponoszenia kosztów. Niestety opłata została pobrana natychmiast, a mój wniosek o zwrot środków został odrzucony, mimo że nie korzystałam z aplikacji ani przez chwilę.
Poza tym aplikacja nie radzi sobie z podstawowymi zadaniami. Szczególnie w przypadku modyfikacji zdjęć działa bardzo słabo – efekty są nienaturalne, niedokładne i zupełnie niezgodne z opisem. Zdecydowanie nie polecam, zarówno ze względu na jakość działania, jak i podejście do klienta.

reviews.title: Productivity Powerhouse with Room to Grow.
reviews.text: ChatOn AI is a fantastic app that significantly boosts productivity and utility. Its wide range of options makes it well worth the purchase, especially at its current price point, which I hope they maintain to keep their customers happy. However, there are several areas that need improvement. The app takes a considerable amount of time to open, and the absence of a chat history search feature is a notable drawback. Additionally, the app tends to reload and erase typed content when switching to other mobile apps; when you go back to ChatOn AI, you need to wait until it opens, and whatever you were working on is gone, which can be frustrating. Battery drain is also a concern, as it seems to deplete the battery faster than other apps on my iPhone 15. Image creation is also notably poor, with very low quality results compared to tools like ChatGPT. However, if you don't need image creation, audio transcription, or video support, the app is excellent for online searches, summarizing articles, and assisting with grammar and content creation. That said, it's important to carefully review the output, as it sometimes struggles to follow instructions precisely, such as adhering to specific character limits or including all specified titles in a search. When analyzing PDF documents, it often provides accurate answers initially but resorts to generic responses after a few questions, indicating it may not be fully processing the document.
